light_timing.field_model: legacy analytic radial light; no noise or occlusion
light_timing.override_scope: ambient light only; latency is experimental, not catalog nominal

body_environment_spec.mechanics: independent output shaft; signed compliant joint equality to wheel

controller_spec.evidence_definition: (positive-probe lux slope minus negative-probe lux slope) / 2
controller_spec.evidence_estimator: least-squares slope of unique unsaturated delivered light samples captured from probe+0.4 s through probe+1.0 s; late arrivals retained during washout
controller_spec.memory_scope: one run; reset clears all state; pause must not call act
controller_spec.preference_rule: paired slopes must both exceed max(0.02 lx/s, 0.001/s * maximum paired mean lux) in opposite directions; otherwise preference zero
controller_spec.probe_order: reset enumeration, retained under ID relabel; act collection ordering does not affect results
controller_spec.seeking_rule: constant bounded effort in each retained local sign; no further learning or moving-source tracking

hypotheses: Paired individual motor probes can expose different local light-response signs after a transmission reversal.
A disconnected shaft may produce little or contradictory light-response evidence, which does not by itself identify disconnection.
Individual probing may improve useful control compared with broadcasting one shared direction; results on this small family may also refute that benefit.
measurements: privileged final pose for reporting only
